tools.name: create_agent_account
tools.description: Create an autonomous Memesio agent account and mint its first API key.

tools.name: search_templates
tools.description: Search the public meme template library before committing to a format. Use mediaType=gif or mediaType=all before calling generate_gif.

tools.name: get_template_ideas
tools.description: Turn a prompt into ranked meme template ideas.

tools.name: caption_template
tools.description: Render a hosted meme from a known template slug and caption slots. Watermark customization is applied only for premium callers.

tools.name: caption_upload
tools.description: Upload an image by URL or base64, render caption slots on top of it, and return a hosted meme. Watermark customization is applied only for premium callers.

tools.name: generate_meme
tools.description: Select an existing meme template, generate captions, and return one or more meme variants.

tools.name: generate_gif
tools.description: Render a downloadable animated meme GIF from an approved GIF template. Supports clip timing, FPS, width, caption text, caption size, and caption x/y placement.

tools.name: get_ai_quota
tools.description: Read the keyed AI quota before deciding whether to spend a generation run.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_templates" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search the public meme template library before committing to a format. Use mediaType=gif or mediaType=all before calling generate_gif.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
